train_binaural_model: train a binaural speech synthesis model using the Trainer class with config, network, and dataset
run_train_iteration: run a single training iteration with mono, binaural, and quaternion tensor data
save_model_checkpoint: save the trained model checkpoint to the artifacts directory with an optional epoch suffix
review_Trainer_init: review the Trainer class initialization that sets up DataLoader, DataParallel, NewbobAdam optimizer, and loss functions
refactor_train_loop: refactor the Trainer train method to support custom logging or early stopping logic
